withdrawn_claims: 'mov esi, 4 (size argument = 4)' - WRONG: under x86-64 SysV, operator new[](size_t, align_val_t) takes RSI = alignment, so mov esi,4 sets alignment = 4.
'constant 4 ... a fixed small constant, not attacker-derived' - WRONG: size is in RDI (mov rdi,r12), and r12 = rsi - 0xe, a data-derived buffer length.
'cannot reach the CVE-2026-95619 overflow threshold' via a constant size - unsupported and withdrawn.
corrected_summary: See cr02-libvips-aligned-new-callsite-analysis.json. libvips-cpp.so.8.18.7 has exactly one _ZnamSt11align_val_t call site (.text 0x403ab3); alignment = 4; size comes from R12 = (second argument) - 14, a data-derived ICC-profile buffer length. The size bound is not proven at source. The branch is closed by direct runtime-unreachability evidence (receipts/cr02-runtime/*), not by a size argument.
